guides.title: Completing the Goblin Camp: Full Walkthrough
guides.content:
The Goblin Camp is one of the most pivotal locations in Act 1 of Baldur's Gate 3.

Getting In
You can enter the camp through several routes: through the main gate using a disguise, through the Underdark entrance, or by fighting your way through.

Key Objectives
- Rescue the Druid Halsin from the Worg Pens
- Deal with the three goblin leaders: Minthara, Dror Razglin, and Priestess Gut
- Free the prisoners from the camp

Tips
If you want to keep things non-violent, use the Deception and Persuasion checks available throughout the camp. High Charisma characters can navigate most of the camp without a fight.

Recommended Party
A balanced party with at least one high-Charisma character and a Cleric for undead encounters inside the temple.

guides.title: Sorcadin: Sorcerer/Paladin Multiclass Build Guide
guides.content:
The Sorcadin is widely considered one of the most powerful builds in BG3, combining the Paladin's burst damage with the Sorcerer's spell slots and metamagic.

Core Setup
- Paladin 5 / Sorcerer 7 (Oath of the Ancients + Storm Sorcerer)

Key Abilities
- Divine Smite: Burn spell slots for massive bonus radiant damage on hits
- Quickened Spell: Use a bonus action to cast a spell normally requiring an action
- Extra Attack (Paladin 5): Attack twice per turn

Feat Priority
1. Polearm Master or War Caster
2. Ability Score Improvement (CHA to 20)

Playstyle
Open combat by casting Haste (Quickened from Sorcerer). Then on your turn, attack twice and Smite with a high-level slot on the second hit. You will end most encounters in 1-2 rounds.

guides.title: How to Beat the Adamantine Forge Boss
guides.content:
The Grym fight at the Adamantine Forge is one of the most memorable boss encounters in Act 1.

The Mechanic
Grym is almost invulnerable to conventional damage. You must use the Forge's lava vents and the central lava pool:
1. Lure Grym onto the central platform
2. Activate a lava vent to submerge it in lava (heating it up)
3. Strike with the Forge Hammer while Grym is superheated

Practical Steps
- Split your party: one character operates the vents, another the hammer lever
- Use movement abilities (Misty Step, Dash) to stay out of Grym's stomp range
- A single hammer strike on a superheated Grym deals 60-100+ damage

You only need to use the hammer twice to defeat it on most difficulties.

guides.title: Essential Tips Every BG3 Player Should Know
guides.content:
Whether you're new to Baldur's Gate 3 or returning for another playthrough, these tips will save you time and frustration.

1. Save Often
Use the F5 quicksave constantly. The game's RPG systems mean you'll want to try different approaches.

2. Shove is Incredibly Powerful
Shoving enemies off ledges is often the fastest way to deal with tough enemies. It's a bonus action, so you can still attack.

3. Use the High Ground
Control the high ground in combat for Advantage on ranged attacks. Position before the fight starts.

4. Talk to Your Camp Companions
Companion approval unlocks powerful buffs and unique storylines. Rest regularly and speak to everyone.

5. Examine Everything
Right-click and examine enemies to learn their vulnerabilities. Switching damage types (fire vs cold) often makes a huge difference.

6. Ritual Spells are Free
Spells marked as 'Ritual' can be cast outside of combat without using a spell slot. Use Speak with Animals freely.

7. Jump and Disengage
You can jump as a bonus action to avoid opportunity attacks. This is often better than the Disengage action.

guides.title: Rescue the Druid Halsin: Grove Quest Guide
guides.content:
The first major questline in Baldur's Gate 3 pushes you toward the Goblin Camp, but the true goal is to rescue Halsin and calm the conflict at the Emerald Grove.

Main Steps
1. Speak to Zevlor and the druids to understand both sides of the conflict
2. Track the goblin leaders inside the camp
3. Free Halsin from the Worg Pens
4. Return to the Grove and report what occured

Helpful Tips
- Bring one character with good Persuasion or Deception
- Save before approaching the goblin leaders so you can try multiple solutions
- If you start a fight, use terrain and choke points to control the enemies

Reward Path
Finishing this quest opens up new companion dialogue, reinforces your act 1 story path, and sets up several later decisions in the campaign.

guides.title: Save Mayrina: The Auntie Ethel Quest Walkthrough
guides.content:
The Hag's Lair quest is one of the creepiest early missions in Baldur's Gate 3. Auntie Ethel lures you into a trap, and every choice you make changes how the encounter plays out.

Main Steps
1. Follow the clues to Ethel's teahouse and descend into the swamp
2. Explore the hidden lair and locate Mayrina
3. Deal with Ethel's illusions, traps, and masked servants
4. Confront the hag and decide whether to save or bargain for Mayrina

Helpful Tips
- Use See Invisibility or similar effects if you have them
- Fire damage and area control spells are strong against the hag's minions
- Check every corner of the lair for hidden passages and alternative routes

Reward Path
You can earn useful loot and unique story outcomes depending on whether you fight Ethel directly or manipulate the encounter.

guides.title: The Githyanki Creche: Mountain Pass Quest Route
guides.content:
This quest sends you toward the Mountain Pass and the Githyanki Creche, where the story shifts from goblins and druids to Lae'zel's personal conflict.

Main Steps
1. Follow Lae'zel's lead and travel toward the Mountain Pass
2. Enter the creche and speak to the githyanki patrols carefully
3. Decide how far you want to push the truth about the artefact
4. Investigate the machine and the secrets beneath the creche

Helpful Tips
- Keep your dialogue choices calm if you want to avoid an early fight
- Prepare for psychic and martial enemies with strong burst damage
- Bring healing and mobility spells before entering the deeper chambers

Reward Path
This quest can change Lae'zel's outlook, unlock major story choices, and lead into one of the most important act transitions in the game.

guides.title: Break the Shadow Curse: Halsin’s Act 2 Quest
guides.content:
Act 2 shifts the story into the Shadow-Cursed Lands, and Halsin's questline is one of the most important tasks if you want to fully restore the region.

Main Steps
1. Reach Last Light Inn and speak with the key NPCs there
2. Follow the trail that leads toward Thaniel and the shadow curse
3. Protect the portal while Halsin searches for the missing soul fragment
4. Explore the deeper cursed areas and solve the healing of the land

Helpful Tips
- Bring radiance, daylight, and healing tools to handle the curse
- Keep a strong front line because many enemies hit hard in close range
- Travel with a balanced party so you can survive the long act 2 encounters

Reward Path
This quest opens major act 2 progress, strengthens Halsin's story, and helps move the whole region toward recovery.

guides.title: Find Ketheric’s Weakness: Moonrise Towers Infiltration
guides.content:
Moonrise Towers is the central location of Act 2, and learning how to navigate it can change the way the entire chapter plays out.

Main Steps
1. Gather information from the cultists and prisoners around Moonrise Towers
2. Explore the lower floors, docks, and hidden routes carefully
3. Decide whether to rescue captives first or push deeper into the tower
4. Prepare for the confrontation that leads into the Ketheric Thorm storyline

Helpful Tips
- Use stealth if you want to avoid triggering too many fights early
- Keep persuasion options open with the right dialogue choices
- Explore every room before moving on, because the tower has several important clues

Reward Path
This quest sets up the act 2 climax and gives you critical story context before the final assault.

guides.title: Steel Watch Shutdown: Gortash’s City Quest
guides.content:
Once you reach Baldur's Gate in Act 3, the Steel Watch becomes one of the biggest threats in the city, and shutting it down changes the entire balance of power.

Main Steps
1. Investigate the Steel Watch Foundry and the surrounding city politics
2. Track the clues that lead to the control system behind the machines
3. Disable the foundry’s power source and weaken Gortash’s reach
4. Return to the city with the Steel Watch removed as a threat

Helpful Tips
- Expect traps, machinery, and heavy enemy resistance
- Keep a few mobility spells ready for the foundry's vertical spaces
- Try to save your strongest damage for the most dangerous constructs

Reward Path
Disabling the Steel Watch opens up more freedom in the city and makes later Act 3 fights much more manageable.

guides.title: Confront the Elder Brain: Final Act 3 Quest Guide
guides.content:
The endgame of Baldur's Gate 3 brings every major story thread together, and the final confrontation with the Elder Brain is the culmination of everything you've done.

Main Steps
1. Gather your allies and finish the major companion quests
2. Make the final choice about how to approach the Netherstone conflict
3. Push through the last defenses around the Brain's chamber
4. Decide the ending path for your character and the city

Helpful Tips
- Rest and prepare before entering the endgame so you start at full strength
- Bring consumables, scrolls, and emergency healing for the last fights
- Review companion decisions before you lock in your ending route

Reward Path
This quest decides the final outcome of the campaign and wraps up the entire story arc.

guides.title: Battlefield Positioning for Easy Wins
guides.content: Positioning wins fights before the first round ends. Take high ground, hold choke points, and keep ranged characters behind cover so enemies are forced to approach on your terms.

guides.title: Boss Fight Prep with Buffs and Potions
guides.content: Enter tough encounters fully prepared. Cast long-duration buffs first, keep healing potions on every character, and save your strongest scrolls for the opening round.

guides.title: Stealth Ambushes for Safer Encounters
guides.content: Start from stealth whenever possible. A hidden opener lets you pick the first target, disrupt enemy formations, and control the fight before enemies react.

guides.title: Surface Control: Fire, Ice, and Hazard Zones
guides.content: Create hazardous terrain to slow, burn, or knock enemies down. Grease, ice, fire, and forced movement can be stronger than raw damage in many fights.

guides.title: Lockadin: Paladin/Warlock Multiclass Build Guide
guides.content:
Lockadin combines Paladin burst with Warlock short-rest spell slots, creating a very consistent smite machine from early game through level 12.

Core Setup
- Paladin 7 / Warlock 5
- Oath of Vengeance + The Fiend (or Great Old One)
- Key stats: CHA highest, then STR and CON

Level Progression (1-12)
1. Paladin 1: Heavy armor, Lay on Hands
2. Paladin 2: Fighting Style and Divine Smite
3. Paladin 3: Oath of Vengeance and Vow of Enmity
4. Paladin 4: Feat - +2 CHA
5. Paladin 5: Extra Attack
6. Warlock 1: Eldritch Blast and Hex
7. Warlock 2: Invocations (Agonizing Blast + Devil's Sight)
8. Warlock 3: Pact of the Blade
9. Warlock 4: Feat - +2 CHA (to 20)
10. Warlock 5: Access to stronger pact slots for frequent smites
11. Paladin 6: Aura of Protection
12. Paladin 7: Oath feature upgrade

Gameplay Loop
Use Vow of Enmity on priority targets, attack in melee with pact weapon, and dump warlock spell slots into Divine Smite. On turns where enemies are far away, use Eldritch Blast with Agonizing Blast for ranged pressure.

guides.title: Inventory and Economy Tips for Faster Progress
guides.content:
Managing loot and gold efficiently makes every act smoother and keeps your party geared without constant backtracking.

1. Send Heavy Loot to Camp
Use Send to Camp to avoid over-encumbrance while still keeping valuable gear.

2. Sort by Type Before Selling
Group junk weapons, armor, and trinkets, then bulk-sell to save time in vendors.

3. Keep Utility Consumables
Do not sell all scrolls, arrows, and potions. Carry a tactical set for hard fights.

4. Steal Smart, Not Reckless
Use turn-based mode, line-of-sight checks, and quicksaves before risky pickpocket attempts.

5. Buy Key Power Spikes
Prioritize strong early upgrades like better bows, +1 weapons, and important scrolls for casters.

guides.title: Combat Positioning Tips That Win Encounters
guides.content:
In BG3, positioning often matters more than raw stats. Better movement and setup can decide battles before round two.

1. Open From Stealth
Start encounters with your ranged or burst character to gain early tempo.

2. Hold Choke Points
Fight in doorways and narrow paths to limit enemy numbers.

3. Focus Fire Targets
Eliminate one dangerous enemy at a time instead of spreading damage.

4. Use Vertical Advantage
Ranged attacks from high ground are more accurate and safer.

5. Keep Backline Safe
Place casters and supports behind cover and frontliners to avoid sudden dives.

guides.title: Party Setup Tips for Balanced Runs
guides.content:
A balanced party prevents wipe scenarios and gives you answers for dialogue, exploration, and combat in every zone.

1. Cover Core Roles
Bring one frontliner, one healer or support, one caster, and one flexible damage dealer.

2. Spread Skill Proficiencies
Ensure your party can handle Persuasion, Sleight of Hand, Perception, and Arcana checks.

3. Prepare for Rest Cycles
Use short-rest classes and long-rest casters together so your team stays effective between camps.

4. Build Redundancy
Have at least two characters able to revive, heal, or crowd-control when things go wrong.

5. Adjust Before Bosses
Swap spells, elixirs, and gear for each major fight instead of using one setup for the whole act.

guides.title: Dialogue and Skill Check Tips for Better Outcomes
guides.content:
Many of BG3's best rewards come from dialogue choices and skill checks, not just combat wins.

1. Lead with High Charisma
Use your best Persuasion, Deception, or Intimidation character to start key conversations.

2. Keep Inspiration Ready
Save Inspiration points for high-impact checks tied to companions, quests, or unique rewards.

3. Use Guidance Constantly
Cast Guidance before social and utility checks whenever possible for easy value.

4. Read NPC Reactions
If a conversation turns hostile, back out or change approach before locking into a bad path.

5. Match Skills to Context
Swap active speaker based on scene: Arcana for magic, Religion for cults, and Insight for suspicious NPCs.

guides.title: Camp, Rest, and Buff Management Tips
guides.content:
Smart rest timing keeps your party strong and unlocks important story moments with companions.

1. Long Rest Before Big Zones
Enter major dungeons and boss areas with full spell slots and resources.

2. Do Not Hoard Supplies Forever
Use camp resources when needed; dead runs cost more than efficient resting.

3. Apply Long-Duration Buffs Early
Cast enduring buffs and summon helpers before triggering long encounters.

4. Check Camp Dialogue Often
Companion quests and approvals can advance only when you rest and talk in camp.

5. Reconfigure Spells Between Days
Prepare spells based on expected fights instead of keeping one static loadout all game.

guides.title: Quicksave Strategy for Risky Decisions
guides.content:
Quicksave does more than protect progress. Use it as a planning tool before major dialogue checks, trapped rooms, and high-risk steals so you can test different outcomes without replaying whole sections.

1. Save Before Big Rolls
Create a save right before important Persuasion, Deception, or Intimidation checks.

2. Save Before Unknown Combat
If you are entering a room with unclear threats, save before triggering the encounter.

3. Use Distinct Manual Saves
Keep named manual saves at chapter milestones in case you want to revisit earlier choices.

4. Avoid Saving Mid-Disaster
Do not spam saves while your party is wiped or trapped in a bad position.

5. Rotate Save Slots
Use multiple slots so one bad save state does not lock your run.

guides.title: Vendor Routes and Shopping Priorities
guides.content:
Efficient shopping keeps your power curve high without wasting gold. Prioritize items that solve real combat problems instead of buying random upgrades.

1. Buy Accuracy and Action Economy First
Weapons with better hit chance and items that add bonus actions create the biggest impact.

2. Stock Utility Consumables
Always carry lockpicks, healing potions, antidotes, and key scrolls.

3. Check Vendors After Level Ups
Merchants often refresh useful inventory as you progress.

4. Sell in Bulk
Sort and sell junk items in one pass to avoid time loss in every town stop.

5. Keep Emergency Gold
Do not spend everything; reserve enough for surprise upgrades in the next area.

guides.title: Stealth and Scouting Before Engagements
guides.content:
Scouting prevents bad openings. Send one stealth-capable character ahead to reveal enemy numbers, patrol paths, and environmental hazards before committing the full party.

1. Split the Party for Recon
Detach your scout to avoid pulling everyone into combat by mistake.

2. Identify Priority Targets
Mark enemy casters, archers, and explosive objects before the first turn.

3. Pre-Position the Team
Set ranged allies on high ground and melee units near entry points.

4. Open on Your Terms
Start combat with a high-value first hit from stealth when possible.

5. Retreat if Setup Fails
If you lose position, disengage and reset instead of forcing a bad fight.

guides.title: Status Effects and Cleanse Timing
guides.content:
Many difficult encounters are decided by status control, not raw damage. Learn when to remove debuffs immediately and when to play through them for better action economy.

1. Remove Crowd Control Fast
Break effects like Hold, Fear, and Sleep as early as possible.

2. Respect Damage-Over-Time
Poison, burn, and bleed can drain resources quickly in long fights.

3. Carry Antidotes and Scrolls
Keep cleanse options on multiple characters, not just one support.

4. Use Resistance Pre-Fight
Apply elemental protections before entering known hazard areas.

5. Focus Casters Applying Debuffs
Eliminating control-heavy enemies often stabilizes the entire fight.
